1263-4063-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-4063-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Fleshtaker and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

116-4828-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
116-4828-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

2921-6972-7932.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact or creature card in your graveyard.
2921-6972-7932.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ceti Eel.
When Ceti Eel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ceti Eel enters, it triggers, causing you to mill two cards and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

7060-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
7060-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
7060-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

3110-3532-5078-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3110-3532-5078-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3240-5147-6462-7396.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3015-4452-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Rhonas.
When God-Eternal Rhonas dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Rhonas's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Rhonas.
As God-Eternal Rhonas is a Lhurgoyf due to Rukarumel, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Rhonas from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When God-Eternal Rhonas enters, it triggers, doubling the power of other creatures you control until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2033-3490-5434-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Black Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

4200-4605-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Icewind Stalwart.
Icewind Stalwart and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Icewind Stalwart that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Icewind Stalwart token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Icewind Stalwart.
Repeat from step 2.

1874-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-5641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1824-2530-3497-7351.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-3497-7351.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
1824-2530-3497-7351.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Prism Ring triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

1978-2364-7329.description:
Animate Mana Vault using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mana Vault.
Repeat from step 2.

3817-4605-6797-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-4050-5086-5183-6291.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-4050-5086-5183-6291.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

3165-3532-5078-6556.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3532-5078-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

225-539-4249-6844.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 7.
225-539-4249-6844.description:
Activate Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least seven {U}
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Man 2099 trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Repeat.
225-539-4249-6844.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

437-486-1651-5640.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque by tapping it, causing Sphinx's Disciple to become an artifact.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Sphinx's Disciple, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens abilities, untapping it and Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
437-486-1651-5640.notes: You can tap a different artifact in place of Clock of Omens if desired.

2011-4076-4365.easyPrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
2011-4076-4365.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Najeela and Burakos triggers.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating two 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Burakos trigger, creating eight Treasure tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 4 life.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

573-654-5449-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
573-654-5449-5702.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters, Amulet of Vigor, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Gruul Turf.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

2178-5698-6797.description:
Activate Ulamog's Dreadsire by tapping it, creating a 10/10 Eldrazi creature tokens.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Eldrazi token.
When the Eldrazi token dies, Ulamog's Dreadsire triggers, untapping Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

632-1251-2034-3621-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-1251-2034-3621-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

988-3719-5361.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have at least six cards in exile.
988-3719-5361.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice Umbris and create at least seven Treasure tokens.
Activate six Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrifcing Auton Soldier, returning Umbris from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Umbris enters the battlefield, causing target opponent to exile cards from the top of your library until they exile a land card.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrifcing a Treasure token, returning Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Auton Soldier enters the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice Umbris and create at least seven Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1594-1690-2364-2538.notablePrerequisites: You have a historic permanent in hand that can be cast for at most {1} due to Helm of Awakening.
1594-1690-2364-2538.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast a historic permanent by paying at most {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Vault to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the historic permanent cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1594-1690-2364-2538.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Graveshifter.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Graveshifter that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Graveshifter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.

24-1071-5644.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}.
Judith triggers, giving Wheel of Misfortune deathtouch and lifelink.
Resolve Wheel of Misfortune, choosing an arbitrarily large number.
If you didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals damage equal to the highest number chosen to each player that chose it, causing those players to lose the game due to having 0 or less life.
If you chose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to you and causes you to gain twice that much life.

1071-1938-3158-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to you and Volcano Hellion.
Instead of you losing the game as a state-based action, Lich's Mirror causes you to shuffle your hand, graveyard and all permanents you own into your library, causing Rhox Faithmender to return to the battlefield as Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, and causing you to gain life equal to twice the amount of damage dealt to you plus 40.

2882-3079-4999-5284.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Blood Vassal.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
2882-3079-4999-5284.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Blood Vassal due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Hollow One by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.

1322-2544-4024-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Humans.
1322-2544-4024-4050.description:
Activate Horn of Gondor by paying {3} and tapping it, creating at least six 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing six Human Soldiers, adding {5}{U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Horn of Gondor.
Repeat.
If you control seven Humans at the start of this combo, it will produce infinite creature tokens and infinite colored mana.

2366-2757-4684-5094.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Dryad Arbor, untapping Dryad Arbor.
Mesmeric Orb triggers, causing you to mill a card.
Repeat.

147-1379-2337-5256.description:
Cast Wake the Past by paying {5}{R}{W}.
In response, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Wake the Past.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing any player to mill two cards.
Resolve a copy of Wake the Past, returning all nonland permanent cards from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving them haste.
Repeat from step 3.

395-1283-2034-2178-4840.notablePrerequisites:
Hanna does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hanna.
395-1283-2034-2178-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {2}.
Myr Battlesphere dies, triggering Hanna, untapping Hanna.
Repeat from step 3 for each of the four Myr creature tokens.
Activate Hanna by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
